task: Write async fetch_all(urls) with httpx that downloads about fifty JSON endpoints and returns their parsed bodies as a list. Wall-clock latency matters here.

constraints.text: the fan-out runs concurrently via asyncio.gather or a TaskGroup, never one await per loop iteration
constraints.why: the sequential-await version of the 2026-01 dashboard warmer took 90 seconds against a 5-second budget; gather brought it down to 2

constraints.text: the shared AsyncClient is constructed with an explicit timeout
constraints.why: one stuck endpoint with no timeout wedged the 2025-12 batch for 20 minutes; every coroutine sat behind the same dead socket

constraints.text: one failing endpoint leaves the other results intact: return_exceptions=True or a per-task except
constraints.why: a single 503 nuked all fifty results in the 2026-02 run because the naked gather re-raised and dropped everything already downloaded
